description:
A web developer at AcmeCorp has deployed a read-only reporting dashboard that needs to query the company's MySQL database. Your task is to create a new MySQL database user with restricted privileges for this purpose.

Using Virtualmin (or Webmin), create a MySQL user with the following exact specifications:
- Username: reports_reader
- Password: R3p0rt$2024!
- Host: localhost (must NOT be wildcard/any host)
- Privileges: SELECT only on the 'acmecorp' database

The user must NOT have INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER, or any other write/admin privileges on the database.

The acmecorp.test virtual server already exists with a MySQL database named 'acmecorp'. You can access the database user management interface via 'Edit Databases' -> 'Passwords and permissions' or through Webmin's MySQL Database Server module.
